title: UN warns hunger will worsen in 16 hotspots as aid falls and El Niño grows
caption:
The UN food agencies FAO and WFP say acute hunger is set to worsen in 16 hotspots from December 2026 to May 2027, up from 13 in June. Sudan, South Sudan, Somalia, northern Nigeria and Yemen face the gravest risks, while aid to them has fallen by about two-thirds since 2022. A developing El Niño could bring drought to southern Africa and Central America.
